# Hakim Firman

> Full-stack web developer based in Sleman, Yogyakarta, Indonesia (GMT+7). Specializes in Laravel, Filament, Livewire and React — schema, queues, admin panels, front end and deploy, usually solo. Top Rated Plus on Upwork with a 100% job success score.

Hakim builds backend-heavy products end to end: database schema, queues and jobs, REST APIs, admin panels (Filament/Nova), and the front end that sits on top (React, Next, Livewire). Recent work includes a WhatsApp-to-Airtable integration, barcode ticketing systems, QR restaurant payments, and n8n-based automation with AI agents and RAG over client documents.

## Services

- [Laravel Development](https://hakimfirman.my.id/#services): schema, migrations, Filament/Nova admin panels, REST APIs, queues, deploy.
- [WordPress Development](https://hakimfirman.my.id/#services): Elementor builds, custom themes, HTML-to-WordPress conversion.
- [Frontend Development](https://hakimfirman.my.id/#services): React, Next, Livewire, Tailwind — responsive and accessible.
- [n8n & Workflow Automation](https://hakimfirman.my.id/#services): API integration, AI agents, RAG, webhooks.
- [PHP Development](https://hakimfirman.my.id/#services): PHP 8, Composer, legacy rescues, integrations.
